BiblicalUsage: Kid is a crushing, and by figure, calamity. Job 21:20 says of the wicked, his eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's word is blunt on purpose: calamity is not an accident that finds the wicked, it is a cup they drink.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
